sum: This paper presents a novel, computationally efficient method for automatic P-wave arrival detection using entropy analysis of seismic signals in phase space. By representing seismic waveforms in a two-dimensional phase space constructed from signal amplitude and its temporal derivative, the method characterizes structural transitions at the onset of P-waves. It computes the normalized information entropy ratio (IER) from joint and conditional probability distributions within sliding windows, identifying arrivals via abrupt entropy transitions. Evaluated on a global EarthScope/IRIS dataset, the method achieves a maximum recall of 94.4% under optimal parameters (ΔIER = 0.5, N = 5000, M = 70). This approach offers a training-free, interpretable alternative to deep learning models.
本文提出一种基于相空间熵分析的P波初至自动检测方法。该方法将波形投影到由振幅及其时间导数构建的二维相空间中，通过滑动窗口计算归一化信息熵比（IER），利用熵突变识别P波。在EarthScope/IRIS全球数据集上测试，最佳参数下实现了94.4%的召回率。该方法计算高效、无需训练且可解释性强。

sum: This study applies Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSInSAR) to Sentinel-1 SAR data (2016–2023) across Hispaniola, merging ascending and descending tracks with GNSS velocities to construct a spatially continuous 3D velocity field. The results document interseismic deformation gradients across major fault systems. The Enriquillo–Plantain Garden fault is well-fit by a single locked-fault model, whereas the Septentrional fault system exhibits complexity suggesting multiple sub-faults. Crucially, the study models strain in southeastern Haiti and the southwestern Dominican Republic using the Jérémie-Malpasse-Bahoruco oblique reverse fault system, highlighting it as a significant but previously overlooked regional seismic hazard source. This provides a comprehensive geodetic view of active tectonics in the Caribbean-North American plate boundary.

sum: This data publication presents the seismic source inversion results for a specific crater collapse event (designated as p2) that occurred on July 2, 2021, during the Fagradalsfjall volcanic eruption in Iceland. Additionally, they refine path duration models. sum: This study analyzes a 22-year national-scale landslide inventory in Nepal to understand dynamic landslide hazards over space and time. The authors find that recurrent or persistent landslides dominate the landscape, representing approximately 80% of all visible landslides at any given time. Furthermore, only half of the newly mapped landslide areas occurred more than 30 meters away from pre-existing landslides, highlighting the critical role of prior instability in hazard assessment. Both earthquakes and monsoon rainfall leave distinct national-scale footprints in landslide density, persistence, and recurrence metrics. This long-term dataset demonstrates that multi-temporal inventories are essential for capturing the dynamic nature of landslide hazards and optimizing mitigation strategies in active mountain belts.

sum: This paper presents a novel time-frequency domain method for ground roll suppression in land seismic data processing. By integrating the synchrosqueezed wavelet transform (SSWT) with local adaptive subtraction filtering, the method addresses the challenge of overlapping low-frequency energy between ground roll and reflection signals. SSWT provides a highly concentrated time-frequency representation to extract a ground roll model. Subsequently, a local adaptive subtraction filter adjusts the amplitude and phase of the model before subtraction. Applications to synthetic and field seismic datasets demonstrate superior noise attenuation and amplitude fidelity compared to conventional time-frequency filtering techniques.

sum: This paper presents an unsupervised method for suppressing erratic noise in prestack seismic gathers. By integrating implicit neural representation (INR) as a continuous prior within the Plug-and-Play Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (PnP-ADMM) framework, the method effectively separates coherent seismic reflections from sparse, erratic noise. Unlike supervised deep learning, this approach does not require labeled training datasets and preserves weak reflection events. Synthetic and real data applications demonstrate its superior performance in noise attenuation and amplitude preservation compared to conventional denoising techniques.

sum: This paper addresses a critical limitation in the Collaboratory for the Study of Earthquake Predictability (CSEP) evaluations, where the magnitude consistency test (M-test) for catalog-based forecasts is biased by the event number test (N-test). The authors propose a new M-test with resampling to isolate magnitude distribution evaluations from earthquake rates, implementing it in the pyCSEP toolkit. They evaluate this method alongside alternative metrics—including Chi-square, Hellinger distance, Brier score, and a novel Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score—using synthetic scenarios and real forecasts from Europe and Switzerland. The MLL score consistently outperforms the M-test across various scenarios, providing a more robust framework for earthquake forecast evaluation.
本文解决了地震预测合作计划（CSEP）评估中的一个关键局限，即基于目录预测的震级一致性检验（M检验）易受事件数量检验（N检验）的影响。作者提出了一种基于重采样的全新M检验方法，以将震级分布评估与地震频度解耦，并将其集成至pyCSEP工具包中。通过合成情景以及欧洲和瑞士的实际预测数据，作者对比了该方法……

t: A resampled M-test and a Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score designed to evaluate magnitude distributions independently of earthquake rates.
设计了重采样M检验和多项对数似然（MLL）评分，用于独立于地震频度评估震级分布。
Synthetic earthquake catalogs and real-world forecasts/observations from Europe (1990-2015) and Switzerland (1933-2022).
使用合成地震目录以及欧洲（1990-2015）和瑞士（1933-2022）的真实预测与观测数据。
The proposed MLL score consistently outperforms the traditional and resampled M-tests in identifying inconsistencies across all synthetic scenarios.
提出的MLL评分在所有合成情景中识别不一致性的表现均优于传统和重采样的M检验。
The ability of the proposed metrics to detect inconsistencies is sensitive to the number of observations and cutoff magnitude.
所提指标检测不一致性的能力对观测数量和截止震级较为敏感。
Decoupling magnitude and rate tests in CSEP evaluations using catalog resampling and introducing the superior MLL metric.
通过目录重采样解耦了CSEP评估中的震级与频度检验，并引入了性能更优的MLL指标。

Developed a resampled M-test and implemented it in the open-source pyCSEP toolkit.
Introduced and evaluated alternative statistical metrics, demonstrating that the Multinomial Log-Likelihood (MLL) score outperforms the traditional M-test.

sum: This study analyzes a comprehensive two-decade geochemical dataset of soil CO2 fluxes alongside ground deformation and seismicity at the Campi Flegrei caldera from 2005 to 2025. The authors show that escalating degassing closely tracks caldera uplift, pointing to magmatic fluid pressurization at 3–4 km depth and subsequent heating as the primary drivers of unrest. A major gas pulse between 2018 and 2022 focused outgassing at the Solfatara crater. Thermodynamic modeling reveals that ascending fluids pressurize the hydrothermal system, causing vapor condensation in the shallow crust (<1 km) and releasing substantial latent heat. This thermal energy is an order of magnitude greater than required for the observed 1.6-meter uplift. The resulting fluid pressurization and heating drive accelerating deformation and seismic sequences, signaling an increased risk of phreatic or magmatic eruption.
本研究分析了坎皮佛莱格瑞火山2005-2025年的土壤CO2通量、地表形变和地震数据。结果表明，脱气增加与火山隆起高度相关，揭示3-4km深处的岩浆流体加压和加热是动荡的主导因素。热力学模拟显示，上升流体使水热系统加压，导致浅部蒸汽冷凝并释放大量潜热，其能量远超1.6米隆起所需。这种流体加压与加热驱……

t: Thermodynamic modeling of ascending magmatic fluids combined with statistical correlation of long-term soil CO2 flux, ground uplift, and seismic catalog data.
上升岩浆流体热力学模拟，结合长期土壤CO2通量、地表隆起和地震数据的相关性分析。
A two-decade (2005–2025) dataset of soil CO2 fluxes, geodetic ground uplift measurements (1.6 m total), and local seismic catalog records from Campi Flegrei.
坎皮佛莱格瑞火山2005-2025年的土壤CO2通量、地表隆起和本地地震目录数据。
Escalating CO2 fluxes track uplift, driven by 3-4 km deep fluid pressurization. Vapor condensation within <1 km releases thermal energy an order of magnitude greater than needed for uplift.
脱气增加与隆起高度相关，由深部流体加压驱动。浅部冷凝释放的热能远超隆起所需。
Relies on simplified thermodynamic assumptions and surface geochemical proxies to infer complex, deep 3D hydrothermal and magmatic processes.
依赖简化的热力学假设和地表地球化学指标来推断复杂的深部水热与岩浆过程。
First to quantitatively link a 20-year geochemical record of CO2 degassing directly to hydrothermal heating, geodetic uplift, and escalating seismicity at Campi Flegrei.
首次定量将20年CO2脱气记录与水热加热、地表隆起和地震活动直接联系。

kc: Demonstrated a strong correlation between escalating soil CO2 degassing, ground uplift, and seismicity at Campi Flegrei over 20 years.
Identified a critical magmatic gas pulse between 2018 and 2022 focused beneath the Solfatara crater.
Quantified the thermal energy from vapor condensation, showing it exceeds the energy required for the 1.6 m uplift by an order of magnitude.
展示了坎皮佛莱格瑞火山20年来土壤CO2脱气、地表隆起和地震活动之间的强相关性。
识别出2018至2022年间聚焦于Solfatara喷火口下方的关键岩浆气体脉冲。
量化了蒸汽冷凝释放的热能，表明其比1.6米地表隆起所需能量高出一个数量级。
me: Long-term geochemical monitoring of soil CO2 fluxes.
Thermodynamic modeling of ascending magmatic fluids and hydrothermal vapor condensation.
Correlation analysis of geochemical, geodetic (uplift), and seismic catalog data.
土壤CO2通量的长期地球化学监测。
上升岩浆流体和水热蒸汽冷凝的热力学模拟。
地球化学、大地测量（隆起）和地震目录数据的相关性分析。

Geodetic measurements of ground uplift (1.6 meters since 2005).

地震目录数据，包括2021年开始的具有短事件间隔的地震序列。

Direct measurements of deep fluid pressure and temperature are limited, relying on surface proxies and modeling.
热力学模型简化了破火山口复杂的三维非均匀管道系统。
深部流体压力和温度的直接测量受限，依赖于地表代理指标和模拟。

sum: This perspective paper reviews the tectonic history of East Asian continental blocks, proposing the 'Asiana' hypothesis. During the late Paleozoic, while most continents formed Pangea, East Asian blocks remained separate, assembling in the Triassic to form Asiana—a major continent the size of South America. Using an updated paleomagnetic database, the authors reconstruct Asiana's paleolatitude paths, showing its subtropical Northern Hemisphere position and subsequent 2000-3000 km northward migration to collide with Eurussia in the early Cretaceous. The paper highlights key enigmas, such as the lack of widespread intracontinental shortening despite massive convergence, and links Asiana's subduction history to the seismically imaged 'slab graveyard' in the deep mantle beneath Asia. This framework has profound implications for paleoclimate, biogeography, and mantle geodynamics.
本文提出“Asiana”大陆假说，重建了东亚陆块的构造演化。在联合古陆时期，东亚陆块保持独立并在三叠纪汇聚成Asiana大陆。利用古地磁数据重建的古纬度路径显示，该大陆在早白垩世向北漂移并与欧俄大陆碰撞。研究指出，其俯冲消亡残留体在亚洲深部地幔中被成像为“板块墓地”。该假说对古气候、生物地理和地幔动……

t: Compilation and analysis of an updated paleomagnetic database to compute site-level paleolatitude paths for East Asian blocks.
编译并分析最新的古地磁数据库，计算东亚陆块位点级别的古纬度路径。
An up-to-date paleomagnetic database of East Asian blocks and deep-mantle seismic tomography models showing subducted slab remains.
最新的东亚陆块古地磁数据库以及显示俯冲板块残留的深部地幔地震层析成像模型。
Reconstruction of Asiana's 2000-3000 km northward migration in the early Cretaceous and its linkage to the deep-mantle slab graveyard.
重建了Asiana在早白垩世向北漂移2000-3000千米的路径，并将其与深部地幔板块墓地联系起来。
Unconstrained locations of Triassic-Jurassic land bridges and lack of widespread geological records of intracontinental shortening.
三叠纪-侏罗纪陆桥位置未定，且缺乏广泛的陆内缩短地质记录。
Proposing the 'Asiana' hypothesis as a major non-Pangea continent and linking its evolution to deep mantle structures.
首次提出“Asiana”独立大陆假说，并将其演化与深部地幔结构相联系。

kc: Proposes the 'Asiana' hypothesis, defining a major Triassic-Jurassic continent in East Asia that was never part of Pangea.
Reconstructs site-level paleolatitude paths for East Asian blocks using an updated paleomagnetic database.
Links the tectonic assembly and subduction of Asiana to the deep-mantle 'slab graveyard' imaged beneath Asia.
提出了“Asiana”大陆假说，定义了一个在三叠纪至侏罗纪时期从未加入联合古陆的东亚独立大陆。
利用更新的古地磁数据库，重建了东亚各陆块位点级别的古纬度路径。
将Asiana大陆的构造汇聚与俯冲历史与亚洲下方深部地幔成像中的“板块墓地”联系起来。
me: Paleomagnetic database compilation and analysis to compute site-level paleolatitude paths.
Synthesis of regional geological, paleontological (dinosaur migration), and tectonic literature.
Integration with deep-mantle seismic tomography observations ('slab graveyard').

Seismic tomography models of the deep mantle beneath Asia showing subducted slab remains.
最新的东亚大陆板块古地磁数据库。
显示亚洲下方深部地幔俯冲板块残留的地震层析成像模型。

A lack of widespread geological evidence for intracontinental shortening during the Mongol-Okhotsk-Waser ocean closure.

蒙古-鄂霍次克-瓦瑟洋闭合期间缺乏广泛的陆内缩短地质证据。

The paper links the tectonic assembly of Asiana to subduction remains seismically imaged as the deep-mantle slab graveyard below Asia.

sum: The authors jointly invert gravity and magnetic orbital observations around the lunar Dewar swirl to characterize the source of its associated magnetic anomaly. They identify a shallow, highly magnetized, high-density body consistent with buried mare basalt. This magmatic origin requires a paleointensity exceeding 11 microtesla, providing strong evidence for an active core dynamo approximately 4.2 billion years ago (constrained by superposed basin ejecta). Additionally, the results suggest that lunar swirl formation is driven by horizontal magnetization and iron oxide enrichment. This study successfully links a specific lunar magnetic anomaly to its geologic origin, offering key constraints on the Moon's early volcanic and magnetic history.
本研究联合反演了月球Dewar旋涡区的重力和磁力轨道数据。结果识别出一个浅部高密度磁化体，与埋藏的月海玄武岩一致。该岩浆起源要求古磁场强度超过11微特斯拉，表明约42亿年前存在活跃的月球核心发电机。此外，旋涡形成需要水平磁化和铁氧化物富集。该研究为早期月球火山与磁场演化提供了关键约束。

t: Joint inversion of orbital gravity and magnetic observations to model the subsurface density and magnetization structure.
联合反演轨道重力和磁力观测数据，以建模地下密度和磁化结构。
Orbital gravity and magnetic field observations covering the Dewar swirl region on the Moon.
覆盖月球Dewar旋涡区域的轨道重力和磁场观测数据。
Identification of a shallow, magnetized, high-density body (buried mare basalt) requiring a paleointensity > 11 μT at ~4.2 Ga.
识别出浅部高密度磁化体，要求在约42亿年前古磁场强度>11微特斯拉。
Potential non-uniqueness in joint potential field inversion and reliance on orbital data resolution.
联合重磁反演存在多解性，且受限于轨道数据的空间分辨率。
First joint gravity-magnetic inversion linking the Dewar anomaly to a specific buried magmatic body and constraining the early dynamo.
首次通过联合反演将Dewar异常与特定埋藏岩浆体及早期发电机联系起来。

kc: Successfully performed joint inversion of gravity and magnetic data for the lunar Dewar anomaly region.
Identified a shallow, high-density, magnetized body corresponding to buried mare basalt.
Constrained the early lunar dynamo to ~4.2 billion years ago with a paleointensity > 11 μT.
Provided insights into lunar swirl formation mechanisms (horizontal magnetization and iron oxide enrichment).
成功对月球Dewar异常区进行了重力和磁力数据的联合反演。

为月球旋涡的形成机制（水平磁化和铁氧化物富集）提供了新见解。

Geological age constraining using superposed basin ejecta.
轨道重力和磁力观测数据的联合反演。
利用叠加盆地喷出物进行地质年龄约束。

Lack of direct samples from the Dewar region to ground-truth the mineralogy and paleointensity.

sum: This study uses 3D spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations to investigate how shallow sedimentary layers affect earthquake rupture propagation across extensional and compressional strike-slip stepovers. The authors demonstrate that sedimentary layers significantly facilitate rupture jumps across extensional stepovers, especially under high-prestress conditions with supershear rupture. This enhancement is driven by sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and the sediment-bedrock interface, which maintains high dynamic Coulomb stress at large distances. Conversely, the effect is weaker and regime-dependent across compressional stepovers. Under optimal conditions, critical jump distances can reach 35–40 km. These findings highlight the critical role of shallow geological structures in controlling multifault earthquake hazards.
本研究利用三维自发动力学破裂模拟，探讨了浅部沉积层对拉张型和挤压型走滑断层阶区地震破裂跨越的影响。结果表明，在超剪切破裂和高初始应力条件下，沉积层能显著促进破裂跨越拉张型阶区。这种促进作用源于在自由表面与沉积-基岩界面之间往复反射的沉积引导马赫波，它在较大距离处维持了有利的动态库仑应力。而在挤压型阶……

t: Three-dimensional spontaneous dynamic-rupture simulations analyzing rupture propagation across extensional and compressional strike-slip stepovers.
采用三维自发动力学破裂模拟，分析跨越拉张和挤压型走滑阶区的破裂传播。
Synthetic numerical models of strike-slip faults embedded in a layered medium consisting of a shallow sedimentary layer over bedrock.
嵌入在分层介质（基岩上覆浅部沉积层）中的走滑断层合成数值模型。
Sedimentary layers enable maximum extensional critical jump distances of 35-40 km under high stress, facilitated by sediment-guided Mach waves.
在高应力下，沉积层引导的马赫波使最大拉张临界跨越距离达到35-40公里。
The maximum jump distances are conditional on specific reference stress, friction assumptions, and shallow stress/residual strength parameters.
最大跨越距离取决于特定的参考应力、摩擦力假设以及浅部应力和残留强度。
Identifies sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and sediment-bedrock interface as a key mechanism for extra-wide rupture jumps.
首次提出在自由面与沉积-基岩界面间反射的沉积引导马赫波是实现超宽破裂跨越的关键机制。

kc: Demonstrated that shallow sedimentary layers can dramatically increase the critical rupture jump distance across extensional stepovers (up to 35-40 km under high prestress).
Identified sediment-guided Mach waves reflecting between the free surface and sediment-bedrock interface as the primary physical mechanism sustaining dynamic Coulomb stress.
Revealed that the sediment effect is weaker and regime-dependent across compressional stepovers compared to extensional ones.
证明了浅部沉积层可以显著增加拉张型阶区处的临界破裂跨越距离（在高预应力下可达35-40公里）。
确定了在自由表面与沉积-基岩界面之间反射的沉积引导马赫波是维持有利动态库仑应力的主要物理机制。
揭示了与拉张型阶区相比，沉积层效应对挤压型阶区的影响较弱且依赖于破裂模式。

Parametric analysis of sediment velocity, thickness, background stress, rupture regime, and fault burial.
三维自发动力学破裂数值模拟。

合成数值实验，模拟嵌入在分层介质（基岩上覆沉积层）中的具有拉张和挤压阶区的走滑断层。

The study is based on simplified 3D numerical models rather than real-world complex fault geometries.
超宽的跨越距离（35-40公里）高度依赖于特定的参考应力、摩擦假设以及浅部应力/残留强度参数。
该研究基于简化的三维数值模型，而非真实世界中复杂的断层几何形状。

It investigates how fault stepovers, background stress, and friction assumptions control rupture transfer.

sum: This study uses idealized 2D dynamic rupture simulations to investigate how along-strike stress variations affect the predictability of final earthquake slip. By constraining rupture length to 120 km using barrier patches, the author isolates slip magnitude from rupture length. Under uniform background stress, the final slip order is established within 2 seconds. However, when background stress varies along strike, this ordering is delayed to 8 seconds. This delay is not caused by a slower rupture front but is a consequence of stress heterogeneity. The findings suggest that local stress variations around the fault zone can significantly delay the emergence of deterministic features in earthquake rupture growth, with implications for early magnitude estimation.
本研究采用二维动力学破裂模拟，探讨了沿走向的应力变化对地震最终滑动量顺序确定的影响。通过在断层两端设置障碍以固定破裂长度，研究发现：在均匀背景应力下，最终滑动顺序在2秒内即可确定；而当背景应力沿走向变化时，该顺序的确定被延迟至8秒。这种延迟并非由破裂变慢引起，表明应力非均匀性会显著延迟破裂确定性特征……

t: Idealized two-dimensional dynamic rupture simulations on a fixed-length fault governed by a single friction law.
在受单一摩擦定律控制的固定长度断层上进行简化的二维动力学破裂模拟。
Synthetic rupture catalogs containing 259 events under uniform stress and 230 events under along-strike varying stress.
包含均匀应力下259次事件和沿走向变化应力下230次事件的合成破裂编目。
Final slip order is established by 2 s under uniform stress, but delayed to 8 s under along-strike varying stress.
均匀应力下最终滑动顺序在2秒内确定，而沿走向变化应力下则延迟至8秒。
The model is restricted to idealized 2D simulations with no real-world field records or complex 3D geometries.

sum: The paper introduces ShallowLandslider, a hybrid physical-statistical framework that couples critical-acceleration slope-stability calculations with stochastic realizations of discrete landslide populations. Applying this model to two subregions affected by the 2015 Gorkha earthquake in Nepal, the authors evaluate how different regolith thickness models (uniform vs. spatially variable) affect the prediction of landslide area, elevation, slope, and aspect. Spatially variable regolith thickness models consistently outperform uniform-thickness baselines. Specifically, high-relief bedrock terrain is best modeled by elevation-dependent thinning and curvature-informed representations, whereas lower-relief terrain is best represented by curvature-informed local topographic convergence. This study highlights that landscape-scale regolith organization strongly controls coseismic shallow landslides and demonstrates how landslide inventories can constrain regolith distribution models.

sum: This paper introduces a depth-progressive framework for 3D seismic velocity model building (VMB) using 2D generative diffusion models. To bypass the high computational and memory costs of native 3D neural networks, the authors map the depth dimension of 3D velocity patches to the channel dimension of a 2D U-Net. The model sequentially synthesizes overlapping depth patches from shallow to deep, conditioning deeper predictions on shallower ones and geophysical constraints (e.g., well logs). A depth-attenuated Gaussian blending scheme merges overlapping predictions into coherent 3D volumes. Tested on Overthrust, SEAM Arid, SEG/EAGE, and Marmousi models, the method demonstrates high accuracy, reduced parameter count, and lower training/inference costs compared to 3D benchmarks.
本文提出了一种利用2D生成式扩散模型进行3D地震速度模型构建（VMB）的深度渐进式框架。为解决原生3D神经网络计算和内存成本高昂的问题，该方法将3D速度块的深度维度映射为2D U-Net的通道维度。模型自浅至深顺序合成重叠的深度块，并将深部预测约束于浅部信息及井测等地球物理约束。推断时，采用深度衰减……

sum: This paper presents a latent diffusion framework for generating 2D and 3D subsurface fracture networks under unconditional and sparse observation-conditioned scenarios. Fractures are represented as binary fields and compressed using a variational autoencoder (VAE) into compact latent spaces, where an Elucidated Diffusion Model (EDM) learns their spatial distribution. Sparse borehole data are integrated via a conditioning encoder, classifier-free guidance, and diffusion posterior sampling. The generated ensembles accurately reproduce key geometric statistics (e.g., fracture area/volume fraction, chord-length distributions) and match multiphase flow responses (gas production) of reference networks. The method achieves high conditioning accuracy (99.6% in 2D, 84.2% in 3D), demonstrating its potential for probabilistic reservoir characterization and uncertainty quantification.
提出一种潜在扩散框架，用于生成二维和三维地下裂缝网络。该方法利用变分自编码器将裂缝场压缩至潜在空间，并用扩散模型学习其分布，通过后验采样融入稀疏钻孔约束。生成的网络准确重建了裂缝几何特征，且多相流模拟响应与参考网络一致，在2D和3D中分别实现99.6%和84.2%的观测吻合度，为储层表征提供了高效的……

sum: This study presents a theoretical and numerical analysis of a semi-infinite hydraulic fracture propagating at a constant velocity in a permeable poroelastic medium. By coupling linear poroelasticity, linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM), and lubrication theory, the authors formulate a non-linear system to solve for fracture opening and fluid displacement. The solution transitions from a drained, toughness-dominated near-tip asymptote to an undrained, storage-viscosity-dominated far-field asymptote. By comparing the fully coupled model with uncoupled and one-way coupled formulations across laboratory-to-field scales, they identify four distinct regimes in the parameter space of dimensionless permeability and effective confining stress: negligible poroelasticity, direct mechanical response, poroelastic backstress, and fully coupled behavior.
本研究对多孔弹性介质中等速传播的水力裂缝进行了流固耦合理论与数值分析。通过耦合多孔弹性力学、断裂力学与润滑理论，求解了裂缝开度与流体位移。研究表明，解从近裂尖排水、韧性主导演化为远场未排水、粘度主导。对比完全耦合与简化模型，划分出多孔弹性效应可忽略、直接机械响应、反应力及完全耦合四种特征机制。

sum: This paper investigates the acoustic modeling of large-volume, low-frequency marine seismic sources, specifically the Tuned Pulse Source (TPS), which radiates energy down to approximately 1 Hz. While spherical lumped-parameter models successfully describe its signature in deep water, shallow-water and transition-zone environments introduce complex non-spherical bubble dynamics, hydrostatic pressure gradients, buoyancy, and free-surface interactions. The authors evaluate the applicability of conventional spherical models and highlight the potential of Boundary Element Methods (BEM) to capture these complex boundary interactions and non-spherical bubble behaviors. This work establishes a physics-based framework for improving low-frequency source characterization, which is crucial for enhancing full-waveform inversion and broadband imaging.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Mw 6.0 Afghanistan earthquake sequence using Sentinel-1 InSAR data to map coseismic deformation. The authors resolve an optimal slip model featuring conjugate thrust faults: a north-dipping mainshock segment (F1, peak slip ~1.11 m) and a south-dipping aftershock segment (F2, peak slip ~0.99 m). Integrating these faults with regional networks, they interpret the sequence as the reactivation of a positive flower structure driven by flexural bending of the Konar fault system. Coulomb failure stress analysis indicates the mainshock triggered the aftershock and loaded stress onto the Konar fault's bend segment, increasing future seismic hazard. The novelty lies in imaging a conjugate thrust system within a positive flower structure in the southern Hindu Kush using geodetic data.

sum: This study proposes a novel seismic mitigation method for subway stations located in the Loess Plateau with locally interbedded sand layers. Using a 1/50 scale physical model of a subway station in Xi'an, the authors evaluate the performance of an Expanded Polyethylene (EPE) foam board seismic isolation layer under a 0.35 g horizontal seismic load. The experimental results show that the EPE foam board damping layer effectively reduces peak accelerations by 13.95% to 14.02% and decreases bending moments by up to 36.22%. Additionally, the isolation layer alleviates tensile stress concentrations, optimizing the overall dynamic response of the station. This method offers an economical, durable, and easily constructible solution for enhancing the seismic resilience of underground structures in complex loess regions.

sum: This study investigates induced seismicity at the Serajeh underground gas storage (UGS) in central Iran. By combining 29,781 deep-learning-based single-station detections, multi-station relocation, and centroid moment tensor inversion, the authors map hypocenters to depths of 3–8 km, extending below the 2.4–3.0 km storage interval. Cross-correlation reveals an 8-month lag between monthly gas injection and seismicity. An objective change-point analysis identifies a sharp decline in seismicity around April 2015, approximately four years after operations began, which persisted despite ongoing cyclic operations. Focal mechanisms indicate strike-slip to oblique kinematics across all periods. The study demonstrates an evolving temporal and spatial relationship between cyclic gas storage and a pre-existing fault-reservoir system, highlighting the value of high-resolution monitoring for UGS hazard assessment.

sum: This study analyzes 24 regional earthquakes recorded by a four-station strong-motion array on a mountain ridge in central Japan to evaluate topographic amplification. The authors compare peak ground acceleration (PGA) ratios with frequency-dependent Fourier and response-spectral ratios. They find that while the horizontal PGA ratio is only 1.13, the 5%-damped response-spectral ratio reaches 6.67 at 3.61 Hz (0.277 s) on the slope. This demonstrates that PGA substantially underestimates narrow-band elastic response on mountain slopes, and highlights that the amplification mechanism involves a combination of topography and near-surface structure.

sum: This study presents the first regional 3D P- and S-wave attenuation models of the Pampean flat-slab subduction zone (29°–32°S) in the south-central Andes. Using a transdimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo tomography approach on local earthquake spectra, the authors map attenuation variations across the crust and lithospheric mantle. High attenuation in the Precordillera crust correlates with major fault systems, while low attenuation in the eastern Sierras Pampeanas indicates less deformation. In the lithospheric mantle, low attenuation in the west suggests a cold, dry mantle, whereas higher attenuation above the flat slab indicates hydration or fluids. The subducted Juan Fernández Ridge shows enhanced fracturing. This work provides critical constraints on the thermal, hydration, and deformation state of flat-slab subduction systems.

sum: This study investigates rupture elongation in buried earthquakes to understand the spatial organization of fault stress and strength. By analyzing the rupture aspect ratio (RAR) from the spatial second seismic moment of 51 finite-fault models (Mw 4.45–7.43), the authors find RARs ranging from 1.02 to 1.59. To explain the elongated ruptures, they perform 3D boundary-integral dynamic rupture simulations. While homogeneous models only produce nearly circular ruptures, introducing directional heterogeneity in initial stress and frictional properties successfully reproduces the observed high-RAR elongation. The results indicate that initial-stress amplitude and directional structure are the primary drivers of rupture elongation, providing a statistical framework to constrain directionally structured fault states from RAR observations.

sum: This study combines Himalayan GNSS measurements with a viscoelastic earthquake-cycle model to investigate interseismic locking on the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT). The model incorporates viscous flow in the lower crust and mantle and a nonstationary locked-creeping boundary. By evaluating 20 model configurations, the authors find that strong locking is concentrated above mid-crustal ramps, and increasing viscosity shifts the locked zone downdip. Crucially, nonstationary solutions (with negative process zone stressing rates) concentrate moment accumulation within the locked zone and exhibit a rapid transition to creep, yielding moment accumulation rates twice as high as stationary models. This highlights the significant impact of rheology and boundary dynamics on geodetic coupling estimates.

sum: This study adapts receiver-function (RF) analysis to regional intermediate- and deep-focus earthquakes within the Ionian slab to image the crust beneath the Campi Flegrei volcanic caldera. By utilizing steep P-wave incidence from deep regional sources, the authors overcome high-frequency attenuation. The RFs are corrected for finite-distance moveout and modeled using ray-theory simulations and global optimization. The resulting model identifies a prominent interface at 7.7 ± 0.4 km depth, corresponding to the top of a magmatic sill (consistent with 2001 active-source data), and the Moho discontinuity at 21.7 ± 0.9 km depth. This novel application of regional deep-slab events provides a new way to resolve deep volcanic plumbing systems.

sum: This study performs large-scale two-phase coexistence simulations of the ammonia-hydrogen system at planetary envelope conditions (500-4000 K, 0.1-100 GPa) using machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory. The authors map the critical curve separating miscibility from phase separation, finding that the critical temperature increases with pressure up to 30 GPa and flattens above it. The results show that the phase boundary intersects the thermal profiles of Uranus and Neptune, suggesting ammonia rain may occur in these planets today, whereas they remain fully miscible in warm sub-Neptunes like TOI-270 d. This provides key insights into planetary cooling and structural evolution.

sum: This paper proposes a conditional mean flows model for generating frequency-domain scattered wavefields, addressing the high computational cost of traditional Helmholtz solvers and the slow sampling of diffusion models. By conditioning the model on both the velocity structure and the analytical background wavefield, the method avoids point-source singularities and generalizes well to unseen frequencies and source locations. The model learns the average transport velocity from Gaussian noise to the target scattered wavefield, enabling accurate one-step generation. Evaluated on the OpenFWI dataset, the proposed method achieves lower wavefield errors and significantly faster inference times compared to multi-step diffusion models, demonstrating its potential for accelerating frequency-domain seismic imaging and full-waveform inversion.

sum: This study investigates the nucleation process of laboratory earthquakes induced by dual-well fluid injection. Utilizing laboratory rock physics experiments, the authors simulate fluid-injection-induced fault slip and monitor acoustic emissions to track the spatio-temporal evolution of earthquake nucleation. The dual-well configuration allows for the control of pore pressure gradients and stress states along the simulated fault. The findings shed light on how fluid diffusion and localized pressure build-up influence the transition from stable aseismic slip to unstable seismic rupture, providing critical insights for managing induced seismicity in geothermal and reservoir engineering.

sum: This study systematically evaluates the long-period coda moment magnitude (Mw0) method using 132 large earthquakes (2000–2023) and synthetic tests. The authors find that while Mw0 generally aligns with GCMT Mw, background noise causes deviations for smaller events (Mw < 8.3). To address this, they propose an empirical correction relationship. The enhanced Mw0 method is robust against variations in epicenter location, station coverage, focal mechanism, and focal depth. It is applicable to earthquakes with Mw >= 7.3 given high-quality data, with a highly robust operational range of Mw >= 7.5, offering a stable tool for capturing total seismic energy release.
本研究利用2000至2023年间132个大地震数据及合成测试，系统评估了长周期尾波矩震级（Mw0）方法。结果表明，Mw0与GCMT Mw总体一致，但背景噪声会导致较小事件（Mw < 8.3）出现偏差。为此，研究提出了一种经验校正关系。改进后的方法对震中位置、台站数量变化不敏感，对震源机制和深度仅轻微……

Seismic waveform data from 132 large global earthquakes between January 2000 and March 2023, alongside synthetic seismograms.

sum: This study evaluates and fine-tunes three pretrained deep-learning phase pickers (PhaseNet, EQTransformer, and GPD) using regional seismic network data from deep-focus earthquakes in Northeast China. Using a dataset of 1,638 manually picked arrivals from 2008–2022 and a blind test from 2023–2025 events, the authors show that regional fine-tuning significantly improves P-phase picking, with PhaseNet achieving the highest P-phase F1-score of 0.893 (at ±1.0 s tolerance). However, S-phase picking performance remains limited (F1-scores < 0.4), highlighting empirical challenges. The study demonstrates the value of regional fine-tuning for deep-focus earthquake monitoring while identifying S-phase picking and source-station geometry as key areas for future improvement.

sum: This paper introduces RUGON (Real-time Ubiquitous Ground-shaking Observation Network), a community-based earthquake observation and rapid response platform in Thailand. RUGON integrates distributed MEMS accelerometers, edge computing, cloud processing, and web-based decision-support tools to deliver real-time ground-motion information. The platform supports community notification, structural vibration monitoring, and situational awareness during earthquake emergencies. Sensor performance was verified via laboratory calibration, and field deployment during the 2026 ML 5.3 Myanmar earthquake demonstrated its complete workflow. While not a substitute for a national earthquake early warning system, RUGON leverages the long propagation times of regional earthquakes to provide over a minute of lead time for major Thai cities based on upstream peak ground acceleration observations.

sum: This study provides a rigorous mathematical proof of the generality of solution scaling in linear elastic dynamic rupture models using a boundary integral equation formulation. The authors demonstrate how dynamic rupture solutions (slip and traction evolution) scale with initial stress, fault rheology, space-time coordinates, and elastic medium properties. Crucially, this proof holds under arbitrary fault geometries, heterogeneous rheologies, and complex medium velocity structures, provided solution uniqueness is satisfied. Four fault rheologies are analyzed: linear slip-weakening, rate-and-state friction, linear time-weakening, and composite rheology. This work establishes a solid theoretical foundation for widely used scaling practices in numerical simulations and laboratory experiments.

sum: This study presents a joint inversion approach combining seismic refraction tomography and electrical resistivity tomography to evaluate the structural integrity of supporting pillars in an underground cave in Burgundy, France. Using a three-phase petrophysical joint inversion (P-JIv) on an unstructured triangular mesh, the authors achieved higher spatial resolution and consistency compared to independent inversions. The resulting P-wave velocity and resistivity models correlate well with visual inspections and borehole logs, allowing estimation of rock porosity and water content. An automated clustering procedure was further applied to establish a proxy indicator of pillar integrity, facilitating the prioritization of reinforcement measures. The novelty lies in applying petrophysical joint inversion to engineering-scale pillar damage assessment.

sum: This study evaluates repeated passive seismic surveys conducted over a decade on the unstable La Praz rock slope in France, culminating two months before its complete collapse in August 2023. Using the Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR), the authors distinguished stable from unstable areas and classified rock compartments by rockfall hazard. Highly susceptible compartments showed significantly elevated HVSR peak amplitudes ($aHVSR(f_p)$ up to 157). Crucially, the main HVSR peak frequency ($f_p$) decreased by 11% to 15% in the three most unstable compartments prior to collapse, exceeding typical environmental fluctuations. This work demonstrates the power of combining HVSR amplitude and frequency tracking for landslide hazard assessment and early warning.

sum: SeidarT is an open-source, community-driven FDTD software package designed for full-waveform modeling of both elastic and electromagnetic wave propagation. It natively supports full-tensor anisotropy (21 stiffness coefficients), frequency-independent attenuation, and unified wave physics on a Cartesian grid. Combining Fortran's computational speed with Python's ease of use, SeidarT features an image-based geometry workflow, JSON project files, and CPML boundary conditions. It is validated against analytical solutions and field observations (GPR and seismic) in snow and ice. The toolbox includes physical property parameterizations for ice/snow and homogenization schemes (e.g., Gassmann, Self-Consistent Approximation) to handle variable porosity and saturation. SeidarT lowers barriers for cryospheric research, environmental monitoring, and engineering applications.

sum: This study presents a supervised deep-learning auto-encoder workflow to denoise short-period (1–10 s) teleseismic data, specifically targeting Sdiff post-cursors from ultra-low velocity zones (ULVZs). To overcome the scarcity of clean training data, the model is trained using 1D synthetic seismograms combined with real global seismic noise, avoiding expensive 3D simulations. The denoiser successfully extracts weak Sdiff signals and is enhanced via transfer learning. Applying this method to real data sampling known ULVZs, the authors identify previously unreported short-period signals and document frequency- and azimuth-dependent Sdiff waveforms for the Hawaiian ULVZ along a novel East Pacific Rise-to-Japan path. This demonstrates that deep-learning denoising can significantly expand observational constraints on deep Earth structures.

sum: This study presents a 3D displacement mapping framework using offset tracking on high-resolution LiDAR-derived shaded relief images, applied to the active Slumgullion landslide in Colorado, USA. The method successfully identifies previously undetected secondary mini-slides near the landslide's margins and headscarp, confirming ongoing material supply. By comparing these results with historical displacement data dating back to 1939, the authors demonstrate a long-term deceleration of the landslide's motion, including a ~36% reduction in toe advance since the 1990s. Despite this deceleration, the landslide remains highly dynamic, with maximum shear strain rates reaching approximately 1 yr⁻¹. This work provides a transferable methodology for high-resolution 3D deformation mapping of landslides and other geohazards.

sum: This study uses SPECFEM2D to investigate how elastic wave propagation (focusing) affects apparent teleseismic body-wave attenuation (Delta t*), separating extrinsic focusing from intrinsic anelasticity. Using idealized low-velocity, high-attenuation models, the authors find that elastic focusing can contribute over 50% of the apparent differential attenuation signal, with the extrinsic fraction decreasing as anomaly size and aspect ratio increase. They validate a quantitative quality-control metric based on the divergence between amplitude and phase spectra to identify stations affected by strong extrinsic focusing. Applying this to geodynamic models of mid-ocean ridges (MORs), they show that elastic focusing from low-velocity structures contributes up to 0.2 s of Delta t* near the ridge axis. The small differences in simulated Delta t* and travel times across varying spreading rates and volatile contents suggest caution when using these data alone to infer MOR thermodynamic states.
